name: curved-video-stage
title: Add adjustable curvature to the immersive video stage
description: Adjustable cylinder curvature for the video TriangleMesh with danmaku/subtitle UV following the same surface; UI panels stay flat.
creator: M0e_N00b
notes: CLOSED AS DELIVERED ELSEWHERE (2026-10-02). Originally deferred from the workbench UX batch, pending validation of cylinder mesh vs standard CylinderShapeOptions media panel. That validation happened in 09-10-stage-scale-curvature-bake and the goal shipped in 064219b: adjustable cylinder curvature now goes through the compositor's CylinderShapeOptions (CylinderLayerConfig.radius), NOT a self-drawn curved TriangleMesh, so this task's planned direction (subdivide the quad and bend vertices) was not used. Radius is 1.5-8 m (PlaybackStageCurvature.MIN_RADIUS_METERS / MAX_RADIUS_METERS). Note the PRD requirement that danmaku/subtitle UV follow their own surface was overturned on device: video, danmaku and backdrop now share one curvature, because differing radii made the backdrop fail to dim the video surface and made danmaku clip against the video. See 09-10 task.json notes and docs/research/stage-video-mesh-curvature.md. No separate work was performed under this task.
